exercises.title: A Geiger counter
exercises.task: A Geiger counter clicks at each particle it detects. At every click, report how many clicks happened in the last window seconds, the current one included: that is the measured activity. The counter keeps the times of recent clicks in a queue. Fill Click: drop the times that have left the window, record the new one, count.
hints: A time t has left the window at now when t <= now - window. The oldest times are at the front of the queue.
Drop from the front while the front is too old: for len(c.times) > 0 && ….

exercises.title: The longest run without a repeat
exercises.task: In a text, find the longest run of consecutive words with no word repeated. Return its start and length. A window that grows on the right and shrinks on the left: each word enters once and leaves once, O(n).
hints: Keep a map from word to its last position. Move right one step at a time.
If the word at right was last seen at a position ≥ left, it is a repeat inside the window: move left just past that position.
After each step, the window is [left, right]: keep the longest one (the earliest, on a tie).
